BARANDON, JR., of Barandon Law Offices, Traders Road corner Shoppers' Street, Central Plaza Complex, Barangay Lag-On, Daet, Camarines Norte, who conducts this examination at by videoconference, I being at [the Philippine Consulate General in Los Angeles, or as the Court allows].
